title: Yeasty Hangover Cure Cantonese Bacon Lardon Dim Sum
description: A blend of savory, sweet, and umami flavors to cure a hangover, served in a traditional Cantonese style dim sum package with crispy bacon lardons.

ingredients.name: Vegan Yeast Dough
ingredients.notes: Homemade or store-bought, made with activated yeast

instructions: Roll out the yeast dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch (3 mm).
Cut the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball slightly into a disk shape.
Brush the tops of the dough disks with sesame oil.
Place a few bacon lardons in the center of each dough disk, leaving a 1/2 inch (1 cm) border around the edges.
Top each package with a scallion, a slice of ginger, and a sprinkle of sugar.
Fold the dough in half over the filling and press the edges together to seal the package.
Place the packages on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and brush with sesame oil.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve hot, garnished with additional scallions and sesame oil if desired.
